# PeerJS

`peerjs.min.js` is the unmodified UMD build (`dist/peerjs.min.js`) of
[PeerJS](https://github.com/peers/peerjs) **1.5.5**, taken from the npm package. It defines a
global `Peer`. The game loads it only when you host or join an online game over PeerJS.

PeerJS is released under the MIT license; see `LICENSE`.
